title: Burgerlijk Wetboek Boek 2, arts. 2:120 lid 4 and 2:230 lid 4: the record of a general meeting's resolutions
source: Burgerlijk Wetboek Boek 2 (BWBR0003045), text in force from 1 July 2026, read on wetten.overheid.nl 2026-10-09.
note: Boek 2 sets no contents for the minutes of a board meeting; the company's articles do. The check passes nothing for a Dutch board and says so.

rules.text: The board keeps a record of the resolutions the general meeting adopts.
The record lies at the company's office for the shareholders and others with meeting rights to read, and a copy or an extract is given on request at no more than cost.
